v1.0.63 — Startup-latency fix. No behaviour changes; this release exists to get the sidecar fix below into installed builds.

### Fixes

- **Slow startup on installs with large webhook history.** The `DELETE` that prunes old `stripe_processed_events` rows ran synchronously in `main()` between `init_db()` and `socketio.run()`, so Flask couldn't bind port 5000 until the prune finished. On installs with a large idempotency table — or under WAL contention — this stretched the splash past its 12s slow-boot threshold and left users staring at "Still starting — poll #46". Cleanup is non-critical maintenance, so it now runs in a daemon thread and Flask starts serving immediately.
